claim.purpose: Implement Runtime v3 tracing to pinned Vector OTEL/durable master logging parity

initial.title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][observability] Integrate tracing with Vector durable master logging
initial.goal: Make production Runtime v3 emit through Rust tracing into one pinned Vector pipeline with durable master logging and Runtime v2 OTEL parity.
initial.required_outcome: Runtime v3 has real Vector-owned durable logs, OTLP logs/traces/metrics export, status/API exposure, failure observability, and a clean-log auditor.
declared_scope: pinned Vector config and validation tests
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Production Runtime v3 installs tracing once and emits structured events into Vector without silent subscriber absence.
AC-2: Vector is the only general log writer/router; no custom logging facade, custom rotation, Python wrapper, or duplicate master JSONL writer is introduced.
AC-3: A canonical append-only master log is produced under an explicit absolute state root with Vector-owned retention and buffering.
AC-4: Errors carry runtime, guardian, process, lifecycle, component, operation, reason, error chain, revision, trace, span, and parent context.
AC-5: Secrets are redacted before durable and remote output, including adversarial regression coverage.
AC-6: Normal shutdown drains; Vector startup/death/restart/export failure is observable and fails closed where appropriate.

AC-7: Runtime v2 OTEL parity exists for OTLP/HTTP endpoint and timeout config, service resource attrs, trace/span/parent propagation, logs/traces/metrics, status/API exposure, service env propagation, and durable export failures.
AC-8: Vector exports real OTLP logs, traces, and metrics with bounded batching, retry/backoff, disk buffering, endpoint health checks, and acknowledged local durable output.
AC-9: Clean-log auditor fails on malformed records, sequence gaps, correlation mismatch, unexplained restart, panic/error/degraded/unavailable markers, and incomplete drain.
AC-10: WP-12 can consume the Vector master log for lifecycle acceptance without a custom harness log writer.
authority_boundary: Use existing Rust tracing, tracing-subscriber, Axum/Tokio, and pinned Vector; do not add a parallel logging framework.
Do not touch the #5344 lifecycle harness path.
All evidence and generated logs for this issue live under the issue worktree, never /private/tmp.
initial.task_boundary: Implement Runtime v3 observability parity only; no observatory HTML/UI, no legacy deletion, no provider behavior changes.
operator_constraints: never write tracked changes on main
use typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle tools
use repo-native GitHub tools and approved token resolver

steps.action: Bind #5691 worktree, verify Runtime v2 parity source, and establish protected paths
Implement Runtime v3 tracing subscriber, Vector lifecycle, config, redaction, status/API, and auditor
Run real pinned-Vector proof, strict Clippy, exact-head review, fixes, and ready PR

invariants: Vector owns durable and remote routing
Runtime stdout/stderr machine/human contracts remain preserved
pipeline failures are first-class runtime health evidence
no missing capability is reported as healthy or degraded success
risks: accidentally recreating a custom logger instead of Vector-owned durability
status API overclaiming remote export health
scope collision with WP-12 lifecycle harness
stop_conditions: protected path collision with an active owner
pinned Vector binary missing or wrong version
Vector cannot validate the generated config
real OTLP receiver exchange cannot be proven without widening scope
strict Clippy or exact-head review finds unresolved production blockers

validation_lanes.proof_role: Rust unit/integration proof for tracing, Vector config, status, redaction, drain, and auditor
strict Rust lint proof for touched Runtime v3 crate
real repo-pinned Vector config validation and local output/OTLP exchange proof

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on missing Vector, invalid config, remote/export-health overclaim, unredacted secret, incomplete drain, malformed log, or exact-head review finding.
review_prompts: Verify Runtime v3 uses existing tracing plus pinned Vector, not a custom logging facade or duplicate master writer.
Verify Vector owns durable output, OTLP logs/traces/metrics export, buffering, retry, redaction, drain, and failure observability.
Verify Runtime v2 OTEL parity and status/API exposure are real, not fixture-only or degraded acceptance.
Verify all tests and evidence are issue-local and do not touch the #5344 lifecycle harness path.
initial.review_scope: Runtime v3 observability implementation, Vector config, status/API exposure, clean-log auditor, and focused proof evidence.
initial.plan_summary: Implement production Runtime v3 tracing-to-Vector observability parity with one pinned Vector pipeline, durable master log, OTLP export proof, redaction, drain/failure observability, and clean-log auditing; review once before publishing.
